text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: elevated 5xx and latency observed in us-east-1 for Hosted API and several Dedicated pools. Alerts: errors>10% for 5m, p95 latency up 3x. Investigate.
kyra (oncall): acked. I'm on it, will gather initial scope. @here if you're in us-east-1 stack please standby.
alejandra (sre): looking at traces now — large tail on auth calls (STS/Cognito) and ELB 502s to runtime nodes. Spike started ~ 1759001180.
james (infra): AWS status for us-east-1 shows elevated latencies on STS egress and some NAT gateways in same AZs. opening support case.
observability-bot: Top logs sample:
```
2025-09-07T12:12:34Z service=proxy host=node-03 upstream=auth-sts.amazonaws.com status=502 lat=2900ms
2025-09-07T12:12:36Z service=runtime host=pool-dedicated-a request_id=abc status=503 error="upstream read timeout"
```
kyra (oncall): quick customer impact check: Hosted API errors ~18% globally but concentrated in us-east-1; Dedicated pools showing elevated latency for customers pinned to us-east-1 (2 customers reporting timeouts).
product-ops: flagged priority enterprise customers on Dedicated — CS aware and drafting comms.
alejandra (sre): temporary mitigation plan: 1) enable routing fallback for Hosted API to us-east-2 for non-data-residency customers, 2) promote healthy Dedicated spare nodes in us-east-2 and failover traffic, 3) enable increased retries with backoff for STS calls to reduce tail.
james (infra): AWS case opened 1234567890, assigned to support engineer. I'll add NAT/ENI metrics to the incident. Also flipping ELB healthcheck timeout from 2s->5s as a short-term to reduce flapping.
kyra (oncall): executing canary redirect for non-residency > 10% traffic to us-east-2 now. Monitoring errors and cost impact.
observability-bot: Canary results after 60s: redirected route reduced 5xx by ~60% for canary traffic, overall error rate down to 11%.
customer-success: two Dedicated customers currently impacted: "fintech-a" (pinned us-east-1) and "adsco" (multi-az but heavy us-east-1). CS is on call with fintech-a, asked for temporary routing consent to us-east-2 (data residency question).
alejandra (sre): note — KV cache warmup needed on promoted nodes, expect some latency while warming. Will pre-warm common models.
kyra (oncall): oncall handover in 30m to @sanjay. If we still have >8% errors at handover we'll keep pager.
sanjay (oncall): taking handover at 1759001400. standby for handoff notes.
product-ops: recommend we embargo any canary releases and pause scheduled rollouts in us-east-1 until cleared.
alejandra (sre): root cause hypothesis: AWS STS / NAT egress in us-east-1 AZs showing timeouts causing auth latency -> upstream ELB timeouts -> 5xx. Plan: AWS mitigation ticket + traffic reroute + healthcheck tweaks + cache/backoff.
james (infra): AWS replied: "we see elevated network path latency for control plane egress, mitigations in progress." ETA unknown.
kyra (oncall): compiling incident notes and next steps. Will include ticket 1234567890 and link to runbook. Handing off to sanjay at 1759001400. If anyone notices new customer-impacting errors ping directly. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident status updated: mitigation in progress, severity=high, customers impacted=some.
customer-success: continuing customer comms, will escalate to account execs for fintech-a if failover denied.
